description: GIM IRT item bank (Public set (615)). Each prompt has discrimination (a) and difficulty (b) parameters calibrated via GPU-accelerated 2PL IRT on logit-transformed continuous [0,1] scores with additive judge fixed effects. Parameters were jointly estimated on all 820 prompts, then filtered.

scoring.formula: theta = sum(a_j * (y_jk - gamma_k + a_j * b_j)) / sum(a_j^2)
scoring.note: Closed-form weighted least squares after subtracting centered judge effects from logit scores.
